description:
After discovering her boyfriend of three years was cheating, being forced into a blind date with a divorced man ten years her senior, and carrying the financial burden of her suffocatingly dependent family, Yoon Seol-Young finds herself trapped in a harsh reality.

Just when she wishes for a way out, Ki Tae-Hwan—an executive director of the Shinhwa Group, rumored to be gay due to his excessively private lifestyle—approaches her.

 *"Marry me. I’ll take you to a higher place."*

In the blink of an eye, Seol-yYung goes from executive secretary to the daughter-in-law of the Shinhwa Group! But what is Tae-Hwan’s true purpose behind this sudden proposal of marriage…?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
